basis: Standard first-party API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges, provider-reported spending or invoices. No Batch, fast mode, regional or negotiated adjustments: the same page prices Batch at half these rates and fast mode at $16 / $80 for both models, and the estimator applies neither. This additive evidence records Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which Anthropic released on 2026-11-09 at rates below Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1. Until this review a prefix rule priced both new IDs at the Claude Fable 5 rates. The IDs are new, so the rates are flat and carry no dated change: no usage under these IDs predates them. stillOnThisPage records the rows the page keeps for Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, which the price table already carried and this review left as they were. pageNormalizedSha256 is the SHA-256 of each page's text as scripts/provider-contract-lib.mjs normalizes it, not of its raw bytes, which differ between requests. Earlier evidence files are retained unchanged.
releaseQuote: November 9, 2026: launched Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Claude Mythos 5.2 (claude-mythos-5-2) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic's verification programs. They cost $8 USD per MTok of input and $40 USD per MTok of output (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $10 USD per MTok of input and $50 USD per MTok of output).
